title: Fortnite Death Sound
blurb: Crunchy, abrupt, and the end of roughly a hundred million matches. Fortnite's elimination sound is a strange piece of design: there is no drama in it at all, just a blunt confirmation that your build, your loot and the last twenty minutes are now somebody else's problem. For an entire generation this is simply what losing sounds like. That makes it ideal for real-world eliminations too — a text left unanswered, an exam result, being picked last for something you did not want to do anyway. Time it to the exact moment of collapse.
origin: The player-elimination sound from Fortnite (Epic Games).
